sections.title: Запрос и допустимая запись reviewer
sections.text:
Fresh Claude read-only design review, owner запускает сам. Target только P3 и её declared supporting inputs; implementation пока не изменена. Закрытые P0/P1/P2/fixtures/OPUS факты не переаудировать. Не запускать product PHP/Pest/DB/CI и не начинать исполнение по runtime Next.
Команда смыслового запуска: task:plan-audit 2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE design; передать scope P3 и этот packet. В этом пакете нет reviewer verdict и нет permission для autoresolve findings.

sections.title: Карта чтения и критические вопросы
sections.text:
1. plan.py show PLAN2 и show PLAN2 P3; P3-design Order/Dependencies/Api и P3-invariants. Прочитать каждый P3 item JSON, собственный literal OPUS input и P3-examples; P3-design-evidence для baseline SHA/provenance. Запустить plan.py check, render --check, opus-coverage check --phase P3 (только structural).
2. Проверить зависимость реального compileable staged API: P3.1→.6→.5→.2→.4→.3→.7→.8, atomic interface+implementation switching, core-only Operations, no aliases/empty stubs.
3. Верифицировать mapping early sequence/lifecycle/event identity against immutable AD17/AD23 и future P4/P5: не скрыто ли перенесена финальная ответственность, есть ли все current writers/caller migrations, разрешён ли unsupported kind ДО записи.
4. Security: все 05 ability rows, locator foreign/stale model, profile restriction even system, single/batch per-profile driver consistency, activity target visibility/cursor, grants/share membership+Manage and token secrecy.
5. Uploads: real bytes/stream ownership/V30 memory child, metadata MIME/policy algebra, staged-once retries, session+outer transaction afterCommit/idempotent result pointers/replay auth, CAS lock ordering and cleanup failures.
6. Scanning: immutable inspector void interface, no pre-commit job, late/duplicate/failed verdict, all content egress incl share/exports/cache/signed URLs/copy+restore laundering.
7. Tenancy: current-only resolver/no invented setter, all-env fail-loud boot/current-null, owner/profile unique index, public token derived scope, actor rehydrate/live permission, worker restoration order/scoped withoutTenancy.
8. D25: concrete affected checks per item, one phase full non-mutation set with V90 acceptance carrier, honest PG vs SQLite proof, external CI/audit boundary not fake local GREEN. Existing waived MySQL baseline not silently widened or erased.
Для каждого finding: demonstrated consequence, path/JSON field/source unit, owning P3 item, minimal correction; questions не defects. Один verdict GREEN/ATTENTION/RED; исполнение и исправления требуют следующего явного owner instruction.

Accepted D26C/D27A/D28A/D29, @plan/knowledge/security-correction-contract.json and @plan/knowledge/implementation-security-assessment-2026-10-06.json mandatory. Research model claims are not proof; audit exact current input closure AFTER completed supplemental design/current authored fingerprint. C01–C04/C07/C08 detailed contract compatibility, durable scan/recovery/private scanner/caches/sequence tests; future C05/C06/C09/C10 owner mapping only, no past GREEN override.
